posts.name: Adam
posts.cooked: It’s definitely something we’ve talked about in regards to flavor, specifically in character bios or possibly on-card flavor text, but as of now there are no plans to implement love interests as an additional mechanic. Something else you may like to try is storytelling through gameplay. We’ve worked very hard to create a set of complex, interesting characters, and a lush world they inhabit, but the adventures are just beginning. We encourage you to explore the interactions between characters and the way they relate to each other, and post the scenarios you’ve created here on the forum!

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: I once had a scenerio where the Freedom Five (minus Absolute Zero, no pun was intended and just now noticed how that worked out) went to stop Baron Blade from destroying Megalopolis, and they passed. Then Grand Warlord Voss was stirring up trouble at Wagner Mars Base, so they promptly responded and somehow got there, not sure how but they did. They were sadly all defeated. So Absolute Zero showed up to avenge his fallen comrades, he also met up with Tempest who was on his way to stop Grand Warlord Voss from taking over any more planets. Fanatic and Ra also show up because Fanatic could sense the disturbance and for whatever reason had Ra with her. They did achieve victory, but at the loss of Fanatic. The remaining trio then met up with The Visionary who informed them about Citizen Dawn and her gang’s plans, so the four of them teamed up to take her out in Insula Primialis before she can move her troops out for her assualt. Victory was the heroes once again, woohoo! And I didn’t have time to go up against Omnitron, but i’m sure it would of taken place in Ruins of Atlantis since it was the only other environment.

posts.name: beevolant
posts.cooked:
I don’t think Wraith seems like the type to love again - though I could totally see them doing a future nemesis-love interest (batman and catwoman anyone?) sort of thing for her since they’ve revealed that she probably gets more than one nemesis.

Since Tempest is a different species and neither male or female in a human sense, my guess is that its mate/s are either other Maerynian/s or possibly that Voss killed/gene-bound them when he conquered their world. There could be a hilariously awkward storyline about some hapless human journalist/cop/other person who works with super heros falling in love with Tempest and Tempest being awkward about human gender norms.

I get the feeling that Mr. Fixer is either an avowed bachelor or a widower and I think that Expatriette is probably a total player/love-em and leave-em type. It would also be interesting if one of the members of the Ennead were an ex-lover of Ra’s - I also read Ra as being flamboyantly masculine, but he could be gay or straight and it would make sense either way.

I think that the love interest thing seems like it’s more fun as back story or if it were in a comic than as a game mechanic though…
